The best plan is to rescue the three adults at Likhu school and defer the three at Benighat farm, for a total cost of 102.

**Constraints**
- **Evacuation point:** Naukunda shelter is the only one, because Likhu school has not been designated.
- **Access:** The direct Naukunda–Benighat road is buried, so all travel from Naukunda goes through Likhu school (21 minutes). Benighat farm is a further 22 minutes from Likhu.
- **People:** There are 3 adults at Likhu school and 3 at Benighat farm. Each adult costs 20 to defer.

**Options compared**

| Option | Driving | Deferred | Penalty | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Defer everyone | 0 | 6 adults | 120 | 120 |
| Rescue 3 from Likhu, defer 3 from Benighat | 42 | 3 adults | 60 | **102** |
| One trip via Benighat carrying 4, defer 2 | 86 | 2 adults | 40 | 126 |
| Rescue everyone in two trips | 128 | 0 | 0 | 128 |

Rescuing the Likhu group saves 60 in penalties for 42 minutes of driving, so it is worth doing. Reaching Benighat adds at least 44 minutes of driving. The one-trip option only saves one more deferral (20), and the two-trip option saves three (60) but needs 86 more minutes, so neither pays off.

load car1 adult 3
drive car1 likhu-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer benighat-farm adult 3
</plan>

COST: 102
